slides.headline: Merlin, the greatest wizard alive, has fallen in *love*.
Now he lies in a hawthorn bush, unable to *move*.
His hand hangs limp among the *blossoms*.
Nimue reads from his own spell book. He taught her *everything*.
Look at the book: his own words, used *against* him.
Look at her hair. Small *snakes* twist through it.
The white blossoms around him are his magic *prison*.
She stands barefoot above him, calm and in *control*.
Her face belonged to Maria Zambaco, the painter's *lover*.
Many think Burne-Jones saw *himself* in Merlin.
Would you trust the one you love with all your *secrets*?
